brief: Owner report on v7.0.1 (tvofi 2026-10-19): the monthly savings entity dropped to extreme negative values. Root cause: #2411 MonthlyLedger._coverage_factor scales by month_hours/settled whenever a settled-hours record exists, but a store upgraded mid-month from v7.0.0 starts that record at the first v7.0.1 settlement, so the factor is in the thousands and the already-negative v7.0.0-era October saving is multiplied by it. Fix: a month whose hour samples are fewer than its spot samples was booked before coverage began and falls back to pro_rata_factor; repairs written stores without migration. Controls: features check failing on main, mutation, legitimately negative null, synthetic upgrade harness.
